sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes>fdacb518b7320110aab961d9ce11a989</includes><macroponent display_value="CSM Sales Rep Landing Page">fccdf6b52b474f104deaf02ac891bf5c</macroponent><name>Dashboard Widget Clicked</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
	helpers.timing.setTimeout(function() {
		const polarisProperty = this.ux_globals.sysprops['glide.ui.polaris.experience'];
        const polarisUserPref = this.ux_globals.userPrefs['glide.ui.polaris.use'];
        const isPolarisDisabled = !(
           polarisProperty.toString().toLowerCase() === 'true' &&
           polarisUserPref === 'true'
        );

		const {getPayload} = imports['sn_app_analytics_w.ParWidgetsDrilldowns']();	
    	const payload = getPayload(event, isPolarisDisabled, this);	
		api.emit('NAV_ITEM_SELECTED', payload);
	});
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 16:39:08</sys_created_on><sys_id>15cdb6f52b474f104deaf02ac891bfdb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Dashboard Widget Clicked</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_15cdb6f52b474f104deaf02ac891bfdb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 16:39:08</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="CSM Sales Rep Landing Page">a2d64a6c2bd3c3504deaf02ac891bf38</macroponent><name>header_message/label</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Hello, {0}!"
    },
    {
        "message": "Hey there!"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var userGreetings;
    var name = api.context.session.user.firstName;
    var userLanguage = (api.context.session.user.language || '').toLowerCase();
    var honorificLanguageCodeArr = ["zh", "zh-ch", "zh-hk", "ja", "ja-jp"];
    if (name && name.length > 0) {
        if (honorificLanguageCodeArr.indexOf(userLanguage) != -1) {
            name = api.context.session.user.lastName;
            userGreetings = helpers.translateSync("Hello, {0}!", name);
        } else {
            userGreetings = helpers.translateSync("Hello, {0}!", name);
        }
    } else {
        userGreetings = helpers.translateSync("Hey there!");
    }
    return userGreetings;

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes/><macroponent display_value="CSM Sales Rep Landing Page">fccdf6b52b474f104deaf02ac891bf5c</macroponent><name>header_message/label</name><preset/><required_translations>[
    {
        "message": "Hello, {0}!"
    },
    {
        "message": "Hey there!"
    }
]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[function evaluateProperty({
    api,
    helpers
}) {
    var userGreetings;
    var name = api.context.session.user.firstName;
    var userLanguage = (api.context.session.user.language || '').toLowerCase();
    var honorificLanguageCodeArr = ["zh", "zh-ch", "zh-hk", "ja", "ja-jp"];
    if (name && name.length > 0) {
        if (honorificLanguageCodeArr.indexOf(userLanguage) != -1) {
            name = api.context.session.user.lastName;
            userGreetings = helpers.translateSync("Hello, {0}!", name);
        } else {
            userGreetings = helpers.translateSync("Hello, {0}!", name);
        }
    } else {
        userGreetings = helpers.translateSync("Hey there!");
    }
    return userGreetings;
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-01 16:39:08</sys_created_on><sys_id>59cdb6f52b474f104deaf02ac891bfae</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>header_message/label</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_59cdb6f52b474f104deaf02ac891bfae</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-01 16:39:08</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ux_client_script"><sys_ux_client_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><controller_preset/><includes>fdacb518b7320110aab961d9ce11a989</includes><macroponent display_value="CSM Sales Rep Landing Page">a2d64a6c2bd3c3504deaf02ac891bf38</macroponent><name>Dashboard Widget Clicked</name><preset/><required_translations>[]</required_translations><script><![CDATA[/**
* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
	helpers.timing.setTimeout(function() {
		const polarisProperty = this.ux_globals.sysprops['glide.ui.polaris.experience'];
        const polarisUserPref = this.ux_globals.userPrefs['glide.ui.polaris.use'];
        const isPolarisDisabled = !(
           polarisProperty.toString().toLowerCase() === 'true' &&
           polarisUserPref === 'true'
        );

		const {getPayload} = imports['sn_app_analytics_w.ParWidgetsDrilldowns']();	
    	const payload = getPayload(event, isPolarisDisabled, this);	
		api.emit('NAV_ITEM_SELECTED', payload);
	});
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-10 01:42:31</sys_created_on><sys_id>8bd686ac2bd3c3504deaf02ac891bf45</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Dashboard Widget Clicked</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_8bd686ac2bd3c3504deaf02ac891bf45</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-10 01:42:31</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
